text: Hi, Mark. Thanks for jumping on. Quick heads up. I use rock sign, so this call is recorded
and you'll get the agreement to sign when we hang up. Is that okay?
Sure. That works for me.
Great. So, what do you need?
We're launching a new product next month. We need our landing page redesigned, plus three
social media pieces for the launch.
Got it.
The landing page plus three social pieces. When do you need them?
Ideally by Friday, October 23rd.
That works. For that scope, my fee is $1,200.
$1,200 is fine. How do you want to get paid?
50% upfront, and the other 50 when I deliver the final files.
Dio, what about changes? RCO always has opinions.
I include two rounds of revisions.
Anything beyond that is $60 an hour.
Fair enough.
Oh, and we'll need the source files too.
The Figma file and all the exports.
Of course.
You'll get the Figma file and every exported asset.
Porphid, let's do it.
Awesome.
I'll start on Monday, October 5th.
Talk soon.
